`jkanime.net#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — The left-rail SkinRave banners reported on steamcommunity.com/market are not served by the page:⁠ it loaded fine in both an unfiltered Chromium session and the reporter's exact filter configuration, with all 883 requests going to Steam/Fastly hosts, no "Remove ads" text, and the site's own centred 940px market layout containing no ad rail. The reporter's screenshot also shows Steam Inventory Helper's own "SIH Features"/"SIH Games" items injected into Steam's header, so the banners most likely come from an extension in the reporter's browser rather than from the site (hypothesis, not proven).

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's closing rules do not cover this report:⁠ it is a plain ads report, not a first-party-ad case, a paywall, a German anti-adblock wall, another anti-adblock wall, or a scam/phishing page, so no policy rule blocks rule generation. Rule generation is allowed; the closure rests on the observed absence of the reported defect, not on a policy block.
